name: Direct Voxel Grid Optimization
definition: A method to reconstruct per-scene radiance fields from calibrated images by directly optimizing a dense voxel grid for density and a feature voxel grid with a shallow network for color, achieving convergence in less than 15 minutes on a single GPU.
summary: Direct Voxel Grid Optimization reconstructs radiance fields by directly optimizing explicit 3D voxel grids for density and color, avoiding the implicit MLPs used in NeRF.
